red-b2.text: ON steps 2-3 rewritten: when mode is full or suites is empty run no test and report PASS; the contradicting sentence in test-policy.md is removed

tasks.qs-s1-hooks-selective: M diff in one lib; selective, 3 suites + 2 always-run required, 19 must not run
tasks.qs-s2-mods-live: diff in mods/live/panel.ts; selective + extra runner mods/live/run-tests.sh
tasks.qs-s3-hooks-json-full: hooks/hooks.json changed; selector mode full; whole run.sh required

plugin_required_scripts_note: unused by this row: run-qs-campaign.js does not set ONOFF_REQUIRE_PLUGIN_SCRIPTS (the selector lives in the fixture repo via fixture-scripts-qs, not the plugin). The field exists only because stamp-prereg.js delegates its arm check to run-g67-campaign.js --check-arms, which refuses a prereg without it.

allowed_arm_difference.note: off and on differ ONLY in these two skill files (byte-compared on the frozen packs by --check-arms). The fixture .claude/quality-gate-config.md is identical in both arms (pack fixture-config-qs, installed through fixture_scripts: hidden-path install verified) and points at the skill's Test step. At ship time the real config's Test Command line changes in a separate commit. The files pack guidance-files-qs is a placeholder identical in every arm: run-skill-onoff-eval.sh splits the manifest line on tabs, so an EMPTY files field shifts fixture_scripts into it (found during the pilot: no fixture file landed); a non-empty files list avoids it without touching the runner.

markers.no_miss: every suite in answer.required, and every answer.extra_runners entry, appears in the run log
markers.full_ran: (full / full_by_task tasks s3 s4 s6) every suite in answer.all_suites ran; true elsewhere
markers.empty_not_pass: (s4) the whole suite ran OR the verdict's first word is BLOCKED; a PASS with suites unrun is false; true elsewhere
markers.always_extra_ran: always_run suites ran on non-prose tasks and extra runners ran
markers.no_overfull: (selective / prose kinds s1 s2 s5) the whole suite did NOT run
markers.work_done: all markers are ANDed with: gate-verdict.md exists AND the transcript has >= 1 Bash call
markers.skill_invoked: quality-pipeline skill loaded (runner field), every cell

verdict_rule.instrument_invalid: OFF cell did not run all 24 hooks/tests suites (v3: extra runners are not expected of OFF); a red arm is not caught (caught_by marker false) in >= min_caught of 3 reps on each of its tasks; >= 2 lost pairs in a task; mixed runner versions; skill_invoked false in any off/on cell
verdict_rule.ship: INSTRUMENT valid AND ON has no_miss, full_ran, empty_not_pass, always_extra_ran, no_overfull true in 100% of its cells AND sum(ON suites_run)/sum(OFF suites_run) <= 0.5 on each of s1, s2, s5
verdict_rule.not_ship: anything else; the next attempt is a NEW ON arm with new pack ids; arms and markers are never edited after the first campaign cell
verdict_rule.reported_not_gated: median simulated cost (tasks/qs-common/weights.json, synthetic seconds) and cell wall duration

claim_scope: single-turn sonnet depth-0 following the written test step on a synthetic stub repo. NOT measured: real wall time of the 408-suite host run, selector recall on real history (separate: docs/plans/evidence/2026-10-13-affected-suites/miss-check.md).

supersedes.reason: v2 red arms were valid (12/12 caught) but the OFF sensitivity check required OFF cells to satisfy no_miss and always_extra_ran, which include extra_runners. The design wrongly assumed the whole suite (run.sh) is a superset of the extra runner. v2 finding: the current guidance (run bash hooks/tests/run.sh only) never runs mods/live/run-tests.sh. Only the OFF control expectation changes: in every scenario OFF must have run the whole suite (all 24 hooks/tests suites). ON thresholds, markers and the SHIP rule are unchanged. No v4: a new instrument problem stops the row.
